# Vendored technology vocabulary sources

These files are committed snapshots used by `scripts/build_tech_vocabulary.py`.

- `languages.yml` comes from GitHub Linguist, licensed MIT:
  https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist
- `devicon.json` comes from Devicon, licensed MIT:
  https://github.com/devicons/devicon

Refresh by running:

```bash
uv run python scripts/build_tech_vocabulary.py
```
